What A.Team sells

Places experienced engineering teams inside businesses to build and run AI systems that carry out work.

  • Agentic Teammates · Teams build business AI agents that the client owns.
  • Intelligence Layer · Senior engineering teams build and run business AI systems.
  • Forward Deployed Engineers · Engineers build task evaluations and systems for further model training.
  • Technical Talent · Technical specialists join hourly or ongoing work, including advisory engagements.
